mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_subscribe_quota (parent_id, template_id, remain_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{templateId}, #{count}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE remain_count = remain_count + VALUES(remain_count), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE wx_subscribe_quota SET remain_count = remain_count - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND remain_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(remain_count, 0) FROM wx_subscribe_quota WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND template_id = #{templateId} LIMIT 1
